agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the retelling, "Friend, that's not a road trip," and "That's getting TOWED." It needs to be reduced to two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: Verse 17 asks whether Gog is the one of whom God previously spoke; it does not explicitly settle that identification. This card turns the question into the assertion that God spoke of Gog in former days. The question should preserve the wording of the setup, such as asking whether Gog is the one God spoke of through His servants, the prophets of Israel.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

agent.problem: The preceding story card says only that God proclaims what will happen in His zeal and fiery rage. Earthquake, drought, and famine are all plausible judgments, so the baker has no basis for reasoning to "earthquake" and can only guess the unseen wording.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
